verdict.rationale: Granola documents an opt-out of model training via Settings and confirms HIPAA compliance for Enterprise customers, addressing part of the story. However, there is no SOC 2 documentation in the evidence, no detail on enforceability of the opt-out at an org/admin level (vs individual user setting), and no explicit statement on whether meeting data is used to train AI models by default before opt-out. missing for 10: SOC 2 attestation/report evidence, admin-level (org-wide) enforcement of training opt-out rather than per-user toggle, clear default-state disclosure on data usage for training.
